profile.name: James Whitaker
profile.headline: The Pro PMC owner · a management company, not his own flats
profile.bio: James is 51. He runs a short-let management company in South London. The units belong to other owners. He has two people on payroll: an ops coordinator who chases cleans and access, and someone on guest comms. They all use his Host login. There are no roles. Owner reports go out as a spreadsheet he builds on Sunday. He is not looking for another host app. He needs to operate the business: staff who can do their job on the units they are assigned, owners who can see what they should see, and a view of the company that is not one shared password.

facts.label: Portfolio
facts.value: Units for other owners, South London

facts.label: Wants
facts.value: The business to run, not one password

sections.title: Jobs to be done
content: Give the ops lead their own login, on the units they are assigned, without handing over the whole company.
Let guest comms work the inbox without seeing owner money or every property.
Show each owner what happened on their units, without James building the pack by hand.
See the business: occupancy, work, and issues across the portfolio, not flat by flat in his head.
Stop sharing one Host password so a leaver does not take the operation with them.

sections.title: Pains
content: Host is a workaround. Shared credentials. No roles. The company is bigger than the product it sits on.
Staff cannot be trusted with the only login, so James stays the bottleneck for anything sensitive.
Owners ask for a simple picture. He rebuilds it every week from three tools.
A leaver, a mistake, or a late night in the shared account is a company risk, not a listing risk.

sections.title: Lifestyle
sections.content: James is the principal. He still walks units when quality slips, but he is supposed to run a firm, not sit in every thread. He hired people so he would not be the operating system. Until they have their own place in the product, he still is.

sections.title: Value we promise
sections.content: Hububb Pro is for operating a property-management business: teams, roles, owners, and a company view. It is not Host plus a price. It is in design, not live. Do not sell it as shipping. The job is the organisational one Host cannot do.

sections.title: Tools they use
content: A second channel stitched on the side

sections.title: Product status
sections.content: Hububb Pro is in design or development. Not live. Not Host plus permissions. Not a public claim. This persona is a sample for product and comms work, not a live offer.

prompts.title: Not one password
prompts.body:
Run hububb-creative for host.

Angle: A management company on one shared Host login. The ops lead should have their own seat on the units they run. The owner of the firm should not be the password.
Description: Organisational, adult. Pro is in design. Do not present it as live.

Speak to: James Whitaker, PMC owner in Clapham, two employees, shared credentials today.
Templates: statement, problem-to-calm
Formats: all four
Imagery: none

Do not say Pro is live. Do not invent pricing, seat counts, or a permissions UI. Do not call Hububb a PMS. Do not name Pads Living. Do not claim Hububb is the legal property manager.

Render when QA passes and give me the review links.
